instagram.caption:
The spice rack you are not honest about.
The Cooking Zone in the Kitchen. The step of space either side of the burners where cooking happens with your hands busy and heat already on.

What done looks like:
1. Pepper within one reach of the burners. A utensil crock holding no more than six tools
2. Every one of which you used this month. Pot holders on a hook you can find without looking
3. The spices you reach for weekly at the front of the rack
4. A clear landing space beside the hob wide enough to set down a hot pan

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success cooking zone.
